58: public class ArithmeticPostAggregator implements PostAggregator
59: {
60:   public static final Comparator DEFAULT_COMPARATOR = DoubleSumAggregator.COMPARATOR;
61: 
62:   private final String name;
63:   private final String fnName;
64:   private final List<PostAggregator> fields;
65:   private final Ops op;
66:   private final Comparator comparator;
67:   private final String ordering;
68: 
69:   public ArithmeticPostAggregator(
70:       String name,
71:       String fnName,
72:       List<PostAggregator> fields
73:   )
74:   {
75:     this(name, fnName, fields, null);
76:   }
77: 
78:   @JsonCreator
79:   public ArithmeticPostAggregator(
80:       @JsonProperty("name") String name,
81:       @JsonProperty("fn") String fnName,
82:       @JsonProperty("fields") List<PostAggregator> fields,
83:       @JsonProperty("ordering") @Nullable String ordering
84:   )
85:   {
86:     Preconditions.checkArgument(fnName != null, "fn cannot not be null");
87:     Preconditions.checkArgument(fields != null && fields.size() > 1, "Illegal number of fields[%s], must be > 1");
88: 
89:     this.name = name;
90:     this.fnName = fnName;
91:     this.fields = fields;
92: 
93:     this.op = Ops.lookup(fnName);
94:     if (op == null) {
95:       throw new IAE("Unknown operation[%s], known operations[%s]", fnName, Ops.getFns());
96:     }
97: 
98:     this.ordering = ordering;
99:     this.comparator = ordering == null ? DEFAULT_COMPARATOR : Ordering.valueOf(ordering);
100:   }
101: 
102:   @Override
103:   public Set<String> getDependentFields()
104:   {
105:     Set<String> dependentFields = new HashSet<>();
106:     for (PostAggregator field : fields) {
107:       dependentFields.addAll(field.getDependentFields());
108:     }
109:     return dependentFields;
110:   }
111: 
112:   @Override
113:   public Comparator getComparator()
114:   {
115:     return comparator;
116:   }
117: 
118:   @Override
119:   public Object compute(Map<String, Object> values)
120:   {
121:     return evaluateFields(values, op);
122:   }
123: 
124:   private Object evaluateFields(Map<String, Object> values, Ops operation)
125:   {
126:     Iterator<PostAggregator> fieldsIter = fields.iterator();
127:     Double retVal = NullHandling.defaultDoubleValue();
128:     boolean firstOperand = true;
129:     while (fieldsIter.hasNext()) {
130:       PostAggregator field = fieldsIter.next();
131:       Number nextVal;
132:       if (field instanceof ConstantPostAggregator) {
133:         nextVal = ((ConstantPostAggregator) field).getConstantValue();
134:       } else if (field instanceof FieldAccessPostAggregator) {
135:         FieldAccessPostAggregator access = (FieldAccessPostAggregator) field;
136:         Object raw = values.get(access.getFieldName());
137:         if (raw instanceof Number) {
138:           Number number = (Number) raw;
139:           ColumnType resolvedType = access.getColumnType();
140:           if (resolvedType == ColumnType.LONG) {
141:             nextVal = number.longValue();
142:           } else if (resolvedType == ColumnType.FLOAT) {
143:             nextVal = number.floatValue();
144:           } else if (resolvedType == ColumnType.DOUBLE) {
145:             nextVal = number.doubleValue();
146:           } else {
147:             nextVal = number;
148:           }
149:         } else {
150:           nextVal = (Number) raw;
151:         }
152:       } else if (field instanceof FinalizingFieldAccessPostAggregator) {
153:         FinalizingFieldAccessPostAggregator access = (FinalizingFieldAccessPostAggregator) field;
154:         java.util.function.Function<Object, Object> finalizer = access.getFinalizer();
155:         if (finalizer == null) {
156:           throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Not decorated");
157:         }
158:         Object finalized = finalizer.apply(values.get(access.getFieldName()));
159:         if (finalized instanceof Number) {
160:           Number number = (Number) finalized;
161:           nextVal = access.getFinalizedType() == ColumnType.LONG ? number.longValue() : number;
162:         } else {
163:           nextVal = (Number) finalized;
164:         }
165:       } else if (field instanceof ExpressionPostAggregator) {
166:         ExpressionPostAggregator expression = (ExpressionPostAggregator) field;
167:         Map<String, Function<Object, Object>> expressionFinalizers = expression.getExpressionFinalizers();
168:         Map<String, Object> finalizedValues = Maps.transformEntries(
169:             values,
170:             (String key, Object value) -> {
171:               Function<Object, Object> finalizer = expressionFinalizers.get(key);
172:               return finalizer != null ? finalizer.apply(value) : value;
173:             }
174:         );
175:         Supplier<Expr> parsedExpression = expression.getParsedExpression();
176:         nextVal = (Number) parsedExpression.get().eval(InputBindings.withMap(finalizedValues)).value();
177:       } else if (field instanceof JavaScriptPostAggregator) {
178:         JavaScriptPostAggregator javascript = (JavaScriptPostAggregator) field;
179:         JavaScriptConfig javascriptConfig = javascript.getJavaScriptConfig();
180:         Preconditions.checkState(javascriptConfig.isEnabled(), "JavaScript is disabled");
181:         List<String> fieldNames = javascript.getFieldNames();
182:         Object[] args = new Object[fieldNames.size()];
183:         int i = 0;
184:         for (String fieldName : fieldNames) {
185:           args[i++] = values.get(fieldName);
186:         }
187:         nextVal = javascript.getCompiledScript().apply(args);
188:       } else {
189:         nextVal = (Number) field.compute(values);
190:       }
191:       if (nextVal == null) {
192:         // As per SQL standard if any of the value is null, arithmetic operators will return null.
193:         return null;
194:       }
195:       if (firstOperand) {
196:         retVal = nextVal.doubleValue();
197:         firstOperand = false;
198:       } else {
199:         retVal = operation.compute(retVal, nextVal.doubleValue());
200:       }
201:     }
202:     return retVal;
203:   }

205:   static JavaScriptPostAggregator.Function compileJavascript(String function)
206:   {
207:     final ContextFactory contextFactory = ContextFactory.getGlobal();
208:     final Context context = contextFactory.enterContext();
209:     context.setOptimizationLevel(JavaScriptConfig.DEFAULT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL);
210: 
211:     final ScriptableObject scope = context.initStandardObjects();
212: 
213:     final org.mozilla.javascript.Function fn = context.compileFunction(scope, function, "fn", 1, null);
214:     Context.exit();
215: 
216:     return new JavaScriptPostAggregator.Function()
217:     {
218:       @Override
219:       public double apply(Object[] args)
220:       {
221:         Context cx = Context.getCurrentContext();
222:         if (cx == null) {
223:           cx = contextFactory.enterContext();
224:         }
225: 
226:         return Context.toNumber(fn.call(cx, scope, scope, args));
227:       }
228:     };
229:   }

261:     }

263:     return builder.build();
264:   }

270:   }

275:   {
276:     return ordering;
277:   }

279:   @JsonProperty
280:   public List<PostAggregator> getFields()
281:   {
282:     return fields;
283:   }

285:   @Override
286:   public String toString()
287:   {
288:     return "ArithmeticPostAggregator{" +
289:            "name='" + name + '\'' +
290:            ", fnName='" + fnName + '\'' +
291:            ", fields=" + fields +
292:            ", op=" + op +
293:            '}';
294:   }

296:   private static boolean preserveFieldOrderInCacheKey(Ops op)
297:   {
298:     switch (op) {
299:       case PLUS:
300:       case MULT:
301:         return false;
302:       case MINUS:
303:       case DIV:
304:       case QUOTIENT:
305:         return true;
306:       default:
307:         throw new IAE(op.fn);
308:     }
309:   }
310: 
311:   private enum Ops
312:   {
313:     PLUS("+") {
314:       @Override
315:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
316:       {
317:         return lhs + rhs;
318:       }
319:     },
320:     MINUS("-") {
321:       @Override
322:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
323:       {
324:         return lhs - rhs;
325:       }
326:     },
327:     MULT("*") {
328:       @Override
329:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
330:       {
331:         return lhs * rhs;
332:       }
333:     },
334:     DIV("/") {
335:       @Override
336:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
337:       {
338:         return (rhs == 0.0) ? 0 : (lhs / rhs);
339:       }
340:     },
341:     QUOTIENT("quotient") {
342:       @Override
343:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
344:       {
345:         return lhs / rhs;
346:       }
347:     };
348: 
349:     private static final Map<String, Ops> LOOKUP_MAP = new HashMap<>();
350: 
351:     static {
352:       for (Ops op : Ops.values()) {
353:         LOOKUP_MAP.put(op.getFn(), op);
354:       }
355:     }
356: 
357:     private final String fn;
358: 
359:     Ops(String fn)
360:     {
361:       this.fn = fn;
362:     }
363: 
364:     public String getFn()
365:     {
366:       return fn;
367:     }
368: 
369:     public abstract double compute(double lhs, double rhs);
370: 
371:     static Ops lookup(String fn)
372:     {
373:       return LOOKUP_MAP.get(fn);
374:     }
375: 
376:     static Set<String> getFns()
377:     {
378:       return LOOKUP_MAP.keySet();
379:     }
380:   }
381: 
382:   public enum Ordering implements Comparator<Double>
383:   {
384:     /**
385:      * Ensures the following order: numeric > NaN > Infinite.
386:      *
387:      * The name may be referenced via {@link #valueOf(String)} in the constructor {@link
388:      * ArithmeticPostAggregator#ArithmeticPostAggregator(String, String, List, String)}.
389:      */
390:     @SuppressWarnings("unused")
391:     numericFirst {
392:       @Override
393:       public int compare(Double lhs, Double rhs)
394:       {
395:         if (Double.isFinite(lhs) && !Double.isFinite(rhs)) {
396:           return 1;
397:         }
398:         if (!Double.isFinite(lhs) && Double.isFinite(rhs)) {
399:           return -1;
400:         }
401:         return Double.compare(lhs, rhs);
402:       }
403:     }
404:   }
405: 
406:   @Override
407:   public boolean equals(Object o)
408:   {
409:     if (this == o) {
410:       return true;
411:     }
412:     if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) {
413:       return false;
414:     }
415: 
416:     ArithmeticPostAggregator that = (ArithmeticPostAggregator) o;
417: 
418:     if (!comparator.equals(that.comparator)) {
419:       return false;
420:     }
421:     if (!fields.equals(that.fields)) {
422:       return false;
423:     }
424:     if (!fnName.equals(that.fnName)) {
425:       return false;
426:     }
427:     if (name != null ? !name.equals(that.name) : that.name != null) {
428:       return false;
429:     }

431:       return false;
432:     }
433:     if (ordering != null ? !ordering.equals(that.ordering) : that.ordering != null) {
434:       return false;
435:     }
436: 
437:     return true;
438:   }

444:     result = 31 * result + fnName.hashCode();
445:     result = 31 * result + fields.hashCode();

447:     result = 31 * result + comparator.hashCode();
448:     result = 31 * result + (ordering != null ? ordering.hashCode() : 0);

Post-aggregations are specifications of processing that should happen on aggregated values as they come out of Apache Druid. If you include a post aggregation as part of a query, make sure to include all aggregators the post-aggregator requires.

There are several post-aggregators available.

### Arithmetic post-aggregator

The arithmetic post-aggregator applies the provided function to the given
fields from left to right. The fields can be aggregators or other post aggregators.

Supported functions are `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, and `quotient`.

**Note**:

* `/` division always returns `0` if dividing by`0`, regardless of the numerator.
* `quotient` division behaves like regular floating point division
* Arithmetic post-aggregators always use floating point arithmetic.

of resulting values when sorting results (this can be useful for topN queries for instance):

- If no ordering (or `null`) is specified, the default floating point ordering is used.
- `numericFirst` ordering always returns finite values first, followed by `NaN`, and infinite values last.
